storyTitle: DRAM contract prices head for another 20% jump this quarter as AI server demand keeps outrunning supply
insight: AI servers are pushing memory prices up 20% a quarter while PC and phone demand softens, so everyone else now funds the buildout.
linkedin:
Memory prices are up 20% again, and you are paying for the AI buildout.

TrendForce expects DRAM contract prices, HBM included, to rise about 20% this quarter, with DRAM bit demand growing over 80% in 2026.

That comes as consumer PC and smartphone demand softens, so AI servers are outbidding everyone else for the same chips.

Watch device margins and prices: the AI bill is landing in everyone's bill of materials.

leaders.title: Sit Through the Fall: Why the Recent Chart Is the Wrong Teacher
leaders.post:
A ₹25 lakh portfolio, a Covid crash, and one client who sold: the gap is ₹93 lakh.

Adviser Nitin Bellara says two clients both watched ₹25 lakh fall to the mid-teens; the one who stayed and added ₹5.5 lakh now holds about ₹93 lakh.

His rule: cap small caps at 30-40% so a 50% fall costs about a fifth of the portfolio and you can survive it.

SOIC and Financially Free reach the same view: know what you own, and never let the recent chart teach you.
